__comment: Trimmed but structurally faithful Greenhouse board response (GET /v1/boards/{slug}/jobs?content=true), ids/URLs/companies altered. Job 1 is a complete posting with an escaped-HTML content field and both dates; job 2 is remote (stated in the location, since Greenhouse has no remote flag) with a short teaser body; job 3 has no location.name and must fall back to the office names, and only updated_at; job 4 is an unrelated role that title matching must filter out; job 5 matches on title but is unusable (empty absolute_url, unparseable date).
